import pandas as pd

# File paths for all source tables
path_source0 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_36/test_0.csv"  # IdCausa, Causa
path_source1 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_36/test_1.csv"  # IdDeteccion, Deteccion
path_source2 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_36/test_2.csv"  # Main detailed table
path_source3 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_36/test_3.csv"  # IdActividad, Actividad
path_source4 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_36/test_4.csv"  # IdFactor, Factor

# Load all source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
df_causa = pd.read_csv(path_source0, index_col=0)
df_deteccion = pd.read_csv(path_source1, index_col=0)
df_main = pd.read_csv(path_source2, index_col=0)
df_actividad = pd.read_csv(path_source3, index_col=0)
df_factor = pd.read_csv(path_source4, index_col=0)

# --- Transformation Plan ---
# 1. The main table (df_main) contains most columns of the target table, except:
#    - IdCausa and Causa: df_causa (join on 'Causa')
#    - IdDeteccion and Deteccion: df_deteccion (join on 'Deteccion')
#    - IdActividad and Actividad: df_actividad (join on 'Actividad')
#    - IdFactor and Factor: df_factor (join on 'Factor')
#
# 2. The main table already has columns 'Causa', 'Deteccion', 'Actividad', 'Factor' as strings.
#    We will join on these columns to get the corresponding Id columns.
#
# 3. The target table requires all columns listed, including the Id columns from dimension tables.
#
# 4. The main table has a column 'Precipitaciones' which is NOT in the target schema, so it will be dropped.
#
# 5. The target column 'Dir. vi.' corresponds to 'Dir. vi.' in main table (note the dot and space).
#
# 6. The target column 'V_Viento' is integer, main table has integer.
#
# 7. The target columns and types will be enforced at the end.
#
# 8. After joining, select and reorder columns exactly as target schema.
#
# 9. Write the final dataframe to the specified output CSV path.

# Drop 'Precipitaciones' from main as it is not in target schema
if 'Precipitaciones' in df_main.columns:
    df_main = df_main.drop(columns=['Precipitaciones'])

# Join df_main with df_causa on 'Causa' to get 'IdCausa'
df = pd.merge(df_main, df_causa, on='Causa', how='left')

# Join with df_deteccion on 'Deteccion' to get 'IdDeteccion'
df = pd.merge(df, df_deteccion, on='Deteccion', how='left')

# Join with df_actividad on 'Actividad' to get 'IdActividad'
df = pd.merge(df, df_actividad, on='Actividad', how='left')

# Join with df_factor on 'Factor' to get 'IdFactor'
df = pd.merge(df, df_factor, on='Factor', how='left')

# The target schema columns in order:
target_columns = [
    'Fecha', 'IdAhogado', 'IdPersona', 'Localidad', 'Provincia', 'CCAA', 'Hora',
    'Latitud_inc', 'Longitud_inc', 'Sexo', 'Edad', 'Nacionalidad', 'Origen', 'Extraccion',
    'Causa', 'TipoAhogamiento', 'Factor', 'Intervencion', 'Pronostico', 'Localizacion',
    'Riesgo', 'Reanimacion', 'Vigilancia', 'Actividad', 'Deteccion', 'ID', 'Estacion',
    'Estado', 'Latitud_est', 'Longitud_est', 'T_med', 'T_max', 'T_min', 'Presion',
    'Dir. vi.', 'V_Viento', 'Nubosidad', 'ProfNievecm', 'InsolacHoras', 'Distancia',
    'IdActividad', 'IdCausa', 'IdDeteccion', 'IdFactor'
]

# Check if all target columns exist in df after joins
missing_cols = [col for col in target_columns if col not in df.columns]
if missing_cols:
    raise ValueError(f"Missing columns after join: {missing_cols}")

# Select and reorder columns to match target schema
df_target = df[target_columns].copy()

# Enforce data types as per target schema:
# 'Fecha': string (keep as is)
# 'IdAhogado': integer
# 'IdPersona': integer
# 'Localidad': string
# 'Provincia': string
# 'CCAA': string
# 'Hora': string (some NaNs possible)
# 'Latitud_inc': float
# 'Longitud_inc': float
# 'Sexo': string
# 'Edad': float
# 'Nacionalidad': string
# 'Origen': string
# 'Extraccion': string
# 'Causa': string
# 'TipoAhogamiento': string
# 'Factor': string
# 'Intervencion': string
# 'Pronostico': string
# 'Localizacion': string
# 'Riesgo': string
# 'Reanimacion': string
# 'Vigilancia': string
# 'Actividad': string
# 'Deteccion': string
# 'ID': integer
# 'Estacion': string
# 'Estado': string
# 'Latitud_est': float
# 'Longitud_est': float
# 'T_med': float
# 'T_max': float
# 'T_min': float
# 'Presion': float
# 'Dir. vi.': float
# 'V_Viento': integer
# 'Nubosidad': float
# 'ProfNievecm': float
# 'InsolacHoras': float
# 'Distancia': float
# 'IdActividad': integer
# 'IdCausa': integer
# 'IdDeteccion': integer
# 'IdFactor': integer

# Convert columns to appropriate types, handling missing values gracefully
int_columns = ['IdAhogado', 'IdPersona', 'ID', 'V_Viento', 'IdActividad', 'IdCausa', 'IdDeteccion', 'IdFactor']
float_columns = ['Latitud_inc', 'Longitud_inc', 'Edad', 'Latitud_est', 'Longitud_est', 'T_med', 'T_max', 'T_min',
                 'Presion', 'Dir. vi.', 'Nubosidad', 'ProfNievecm', 'InsolacHoras', 'Distancia']

# Convert integer columns
for col in int_columns:
    # Some integer columns might have NaNs, convert with Int64 dtype to allow NA
    df_target[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_target[col], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')

# Convert float columns
for col in float_columns:
    df_target[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_target[col], errors='coerce').astype(float)

# Convert string columns (just ensure type)
string_columns = [col for col in target_columns if col not in int_columns + float_columns]
for col in string_columns:
    df_target[col] = df_target[col].astype(str).replace({'nan': pd.NA})

# Write the transformed dataframe to the target CSV file
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_36/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
